supplementary_prefix_runs.reason: The complete run reused 14400 prefix tokens from preceding requests. A fresh worker provides the cold64K observation.

prompt_hash_verification.method: All measured prompt bytes verified against preflight SHA-256 of the frozen original full-run fixtures, including both prefix scenarios. Request JSON values match the frozen payloads; serialization key order may differ.
prompt_hash_verification.request_comparison: parsed JSON equality; prompt files byte-identical

energy.scope: 70 measured waves only, including their prefill+decode and request overhead. Warmup, worker startup and supplementary prefix requests excluded. Card energy, not whole-system electricity.
